data.data:
A song of joy, a tribute to Spring.

[Grand Blessings for the Spring] events are now live. Join to earn rewards including [Oroberyls], [Springfest Pastry], and [Emergency Sanity Concentrate]!


▼// [Fortune Connect-and-Win] Mail Reward Event


■ Mail Issuance Time

Feb. 15, 2026 – Feb. 23, 2026 (server time)

※ You'll receive one in-game mail daily.


■ Participation Requirements

· Create a character before Feb. 22, 2026 at 23:59 (server time)

· Unlock the [Mail] feature


■ Event Details

· During the event, all Endministrators will receive a [Fortune Connect-and-Win] mail daily. A total of 9 mails will be delivered over the event period. Each mail includes [Connect-and-Win]×1 (use it to get Oroberyls), [Emergency Sanity Concentrate]×1, and [Sanity Usage Permit]×5.

※ Note: On Feb. 15, Feb. 16, Feb. 17, and Feb. 21 (server time), [Connect-and-Win: Auspice]×1 in the mail will be upgraded to [Connect-and-Win: Luck]×1. Scratch to claim a guaranteed reward of 880 Oroberyls!

· Claim the first mail by Mar. 1 at 12:00 (server time). Claim the second mail by Mar. 2 at 0:00 (server time). Each following mail's deadline is one day later. Claim the final mail by Mar. 9 at 0:00 (server time).

· Each mail expires 14 days after receipt. Please claim it in time, Endministrator.



▼// [A Spring Note, Warmly Crafted] Sharing Event


■ Event Time

Feb. 15, 2026 at 12:00 – Mar. 4, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)


■ Participation Requirements

Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process I: Break the Siege]


■ Event Details

· During the event, craft holiday cards based on what the operators like and complete various stage challenges. Your operators will give you their spring fest greetings as well.

· The event has 7 stages. The last 4 stages will be unlocked at specific dates during the event.

· Complete event missions to earn generous rewards.

· After completing a mission, the rewards will be immediately sent to your in-game Mail. Claim them on time as the reward mail expires in 30 days, Endministrator.

· Complete any 3 stages to unlock the Free Crafting stage. Use it to craft and share custom cards for rewards.

※ Cards created in the Free Crafting stage won't be auto-saved. Endministrator, please remember to save them manually.



▼// [Steps to Sweet Success] Operators' Spring Blessings Mail Event


■ Mail Issuance Time

Feb. 16, Feb. 17, & Feb. 21, 2026 at 20:00 daily (server time)

※ A mail will be sent out daily on these 3 days.


■ Participation Requirements

· Create a character before Feb. 22, 2026 at 23:59 (server time)

· Unlock the [Mail] feature


■ Event Details

· During the event, you will receive Spring Festival blessings via mail. You will receive 3 mails in total, from [Gilberta], [Laevatain], and [Yvonne].

· Each mail includes [Springfest Pastry]×1, [Mark of Perseverance]×1, and Operator Gift×3. Each mail expires 14 days after receipt. Please claim it in time, Endministrator.

· Claim the first mail by Mar. 2 at 20:00 (server time). Claim the second mail by Mar. 3 at 20:00 (server time). Claim the final mail by Mar. 7 at 20:00 (server time).

※ Special Reminders:

· [Springfest Pastry] is an exclusive item for Spring Festival, permanently effective and recovers 40 Sanity upon usage.

· After obtaining Operator Gifts, advance the main mission to [Chapter Ⅰ Process Ⅱ: Remediation Progress] to unlock the [Offering Gifts] feature. Then head to Dijiang and give them to operators.


※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5
